issue_context.title: Grouping server options
issue_context.body:
## 🚀 Feature Proposal

Update the server configuration input to provide a clearer categorization of the options

## Motivation

Increase the focus of some properties; maybe a doc revision could be enough?

## Example

```js
fastify({
  timeouts: {
    connectionTimeout
    keepAliveTimeout
    pluginTimeout
    http2SessionTimeout
  },
  routing: {
    rewriteUrl
    constraints
    exposeHeadRoutes
    caseSensitive
    ignoreTrailingSlash
  },
  security: {
    onProtoPoisoning
    onConstructorPoisoning
    trustProxy
  },
  errorManagement: {
     clientErrorHandler
     frameworkErrors
     return503OnClosing
     schemaErrorFormatter
  }
  etc...
})
```
comments: I think this is worthwhile doing. However we would need to deprecate the other options one-by-one.
Hi @mcollina I am new here and would love to work on this. Any directions would be awesome

Look at the current options and propose a complete mapping to a new grouped structure.

Change the code internally to the new structure, then add normalization layer that converts the old to the new. It should emit deprecation warnings for all the previous options
@mcollina got it. Thank you so much for  this. I will try working on a PR
Unfortunately that's the only one I know.
A helper function may be useful here.

@mcollina I've made a draft PR. Feel free to leave any comments. Also, it looks like a lot of small details need to be taken care of if we make this change.  For example, this line:

```
const initialConfig = getSecuredInitialConfig(options)
```

Do you recommend doing something like

```Grouped params -> flatten it to the old version```

this provides user with a cleaner interface to provide inputs and less overhead on our part (though this looks like us doing unnecessary work since we take in the grouped params but flatten them anyway).
I had that new/old config split in the past it was a significant pain to maintain. Everything should be updated to use the grouped options and the previous properties deprecated.

@mcollina that seems better. I've pushed a PR that uses the new grouped version. I still need to add the method that displays the deprecation warning but rest of it seems to work fine with tests. Can you have a look?

Hi! I would like to take a look on this. Does it still makes sense?
If so, should I start on `next` or `main` branch?

@jhonrocha I'd been working on this in the past. Got super busy with school and other stuff. This seems to be super nice feature to have. Would love to update you with what I'd done so far in case you want to refer it as a starting point ✨
Thanks, @meehawk ! I am checking your PR and I will take it as a reference for this work.
Please retain the original work if it is still applicable -- https://gist.github.com/jsumners/461ef7a64545108635cc437fde112721
Sorry guys, I will not proceed with this. I will focus on something else for the next days.
I don't think we would ever do this, it's too complex with too big of a possible breakage. I'm going to close for now, we can always revisit.
